capabilities: Summarize the current note, a selection, or several notes
Chat with vault notes as context, adding notes with @ references
Generate editable Q&A and concept knowledge cards
Rewrite, expand, shorten, polish, or tag selected text in place
Transcribe audio live and sync Markdown one way into WiseMindAI
extras: Desktop-only; the plugin is free and MIT-licensed, while the WiseMindAI desktop app has a free plan with optional Pro features. Sync defaults to Obsidian to WiseMindAI only and does not overwrite the Obsidian original on conflict.
motivation: The README says it lets you use AI with notes already in your vault, without repeatedly copying content into another app and bringing the results back.
problem: Using AI on vault notes usually means copying text into another app and pasting results back, which breaks the Markdown workflow and loses note context.

relations.evidence: The WiseMindAI desktop app is required.

requires.name: WiseMindAI desktop app with Local API service enabled

summary: Sidebar bridge to the WiseMindAI desktop app for note summaries, vault-based chat, knowledge cards, live transcription, and one-way Markdown sync.
